title: Polyhedrality of Movable Cycle Cones on Toric Varieties
exact_target: Rational polyhedrality, in every dimension d, of the closed cone of numerical classes generated by d-dimensional subvarieties deforming through the open torus of a smooth toric variety.
deduction_scope: Smooth projective varieties over C; the primary sentence does not explicitly impose projectivity or a base field.
exact_gap: No finite rational description of general intermediate-dimensional toric movable cones, and no toric nonpolyhedral counterexample. The boundary-intersection outer cone and all-birational-models description remain only reductions.
strongest_verified_results: Explicit known toric fourfold movable-surface cone and failure of naive nef duality
Explicit Hodge obstruction separating irreducible representability from the convex movable cone
completion_estimate_meaning: No yes/no conclusion for the universal assertion; not a calibrated probability.
